description: Make prose natural, specific, and personal.

defaultPrompt: Revise this email so it sounds natural and direct.
Turn these notes into a clear report in my voice.
Draft a personal LinkedIn post without hype.
interface.longDescription: HumanWriting helps draft and revise emails, reports, posts, applications, speeches, and other reader-facing prose. It reduces formulaic phrasing, inflated claims, repetitive rhetoric, and unnecessary formatting while preserving meaning, facts, citations, and personal voice. It does not promise to conceal AI use or defeat AI detectors.

name: humanwriting
